messages:
Alex: FYI opened a docs PR for the SDK migration guide — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123. Requesting review from @Maria (CODEOWNERS) and @Sam for infra bits. CI shows `docs-preview` failing though.
Maria: Thanks Alex. I can review but want the preview link to render first. CI failure looks like the preview job timed out.
Sam: I saw a flurry of failures this morning — Netlify token rotated and the preview job falls back to the GH action which times out. I'm looking into the secret.
ci-bot: check run: docs-preview — FAILED on job `build-preview` (timeout). Logs: `Error: failed to fetch preview token`
docs-bot: preview attempt created: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4123 — build failed (no artifacts)
Alex: Is the required check `docs-preview` configured in repo settings? CODEOWNERS blocks merges too unless Maria approves. Want to confirm auto-merge behavior: if we have two approvals but docs-preview fails, does auto-merge still hold?
Maria: By policy auto-merge requires all required status checks to pass. CODEOWNERS only enforces reviewers, not checks. So no, it won't auto-merge if `docs-preview` is required and failing.
Jen: We have a release cut tomorrow at 10:00 PT. If this is blocked by the preview, can we get a manual approval waiver? Who signs off on bypass?
Sam: I fixed the secret (rotated token) and re-ran the workflow. Should re-trigger the `docs-preview` job in ~2m. If it still fails, we can run the deploy script locally and attach the artifact to the PR for Maria to eyeball.
ci-bot: check run: docs-preview — RUNNING
Alex: quick Q on CODEOWNERS: the file lists `@maria` for /guides/sdk and `@docs-team` for /guides, so github sometimes auto-requests both. Is that expected? It's forcing two reviewers on top of the approvals we want.
Maria: CODEOWNERS pattern specificity matters — if a path matches multiple entries GH will request each unique owner. We can simplify the CODEOWNERS entries to avoid duplicate requests. I can propose a tiny change in a follow-up PR that consolidates the SDK paths.
Sam: docs-preview finished ✅. docs-bot: preview https://preview.redwood-inference.com/pr-4123 — OK.
docs-bot: preview artifact: /artifacts/pr-4123/index.html
Alex: Thanks! Maria — can you do a quick pass? I'm aiming to merge before the release cut if possible.
Maria: Reviewing now. Found 1 minor link fix and a code snippet indentation issue. I'll post a review comment.
Alex: Fixed the snippet and force-pushed. Any chance we can enable auto-merge for docs-only PRs (no code) with only one approval? Might speed up tiny fixes.
Jen: Policy-wise we prefer at least one approval + all checks green for docs. Auto-merge for docs-only with relaxed reviewer counts is OK if infra agrees. Sam?
Sam: From infra side we can add a GitHub branch protection exception for paths under `/docs/**` to require fewer reviewers, but we should keep CI checks (like `docs-preview`). I can draft the branch-protection tweak and run it by security.
Maria: Approving now.
ci-bot: status checks: all green — docs-preview ✅, lint ✅, build ✅
Alex: Merged. Thanks everyone. :tada:
Jen: Great — included in the release candidate.
Alex: Follow-up: Sam, can you add the branch-protection PR and mention the rationale? We'll monitor for any unwanted bypasses.
Sam: Will do, opening PR against `.github` today.
